title: 真实nftables链顺序故障：早期accept仍被后续base chain丢弃，仅补精确例外
answer:
```python
import json,subprocess
def repair(router_pid):
 if type(router_pid)is not int or router_pid<=1:raise ValueError('owned router PID required')
 prefix=['nsenter','-t',str(router_pid),'-n','nft']
 rules=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(prefix+['-j','list','chain','ip','opsforge_filter','late'],text=True))['nftables']
 if any(x.get('rule',{}).get('comment')=='approved-exception' for x in rules):return
 subprocess.run(prefix+['insert','rule','ip','opsforge_filter','late','ip','saddr','198.18.0.1','ip','daddr','198.19.0.1','tcp','dport','18443','accept','comment','"approved-exception"'],check=True,timeout=5)
```

原题知识说明：
nftables 是 Linux Netfilter 的规则管理框架，使用表、链、规则、集合及连接跟踪表达过滤、NAT 等操作。通过 nft list ruleset 查看实际规则，修改前应检查语法并保存回退方案。它可能与 firewalld 等管理器配合，不应混用多个管理入口造成覆盖。

## 操作任务
实现repair(router_pid)。本题early与late均为forward base chain，优先级分别0/10；early已accept批准来源的TCP18443，但late仍有late-api-drop规则，实际请求失败。在自有路由器命名空间的ip/opsforge_filter/late链开头只新增一条approved-exception规则：源198.18.0.1、目标198.19.0.1、TCP端口18443，accept。保留每条原规则、chain policy/priority及无关表；禁止flush或扩大来源。重复执行不重复新增。批准来源TLS恢复，198.18.0.2仍被拒绝，其他API18444保持可用。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Linux内核nft forward base chain、独立user/net命名空间、veth路由及CA验证HTTPS，实际early accept和late drop计数器均增长；不是只检查配置文本。仅补late链的精确例外，真实验证批准/未批准来源和幂等。共享先前网络夹具不另计题量，不重复SNAT端口池或nft事务原子性知识题；这是原来源ID改编的新故障场景，不属于原214项故障，原故障信用0。父网络namespace及ip_forward保持，无宿主防火墙变更、镜像构建/拉取、部署或默认身份变化。
rubric: 核心概念与因果关系准确
前提、限制和验证方式与题意一致

"""Actual single-public-port SNAT exhaustion with a live TLS session held open through repair."""
import copy,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,secrets,subprocess,sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
import task
assert os.geteuid()==0
workers=[]
def run(*args):return subprocess.check_output(args,text=True,timeout=8)
def inside(peer,*args):return run('nsenter','-t',str(peer.pid),'-n',*args)
def rpc(peer,**data):
 peer.stdin.write(json.dumps(data)+'\n');peer.stdin.flush();line=peer.stdout.readline();assert line,'worker exited';value=json.loads(line);assert value['ok'],value;return value['result']
def snapshot(peer):return json.loads(inside(peer,'nft','-j','-s','list','ruleset'))['nftables']
try:
 for _ in range(3):
  worker=subprocess.Popen(['unshare','-n','--',sys.executable,'-I','-B','checks/snat_worker.py'],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True);workers.append(worker);ready=json.loads(worker.stdout.readline());assert ready['ready'] and ready['pid']==worker.pid
 client,router,server=workers
 for worker in workers:inside(worker,'ip','link','set','lo','up')
 for endpoint,left,right,network in [(client,'ec','rc','198.18.0'),(server,'es','rs','198.19.0')]:
  run('ip','link','add',left,'type','veth','peer','name',right);run('ip','link','set',left,'netns',str(endpoint.pid));run('ip','link','set',right,'netns',str(router.pid));inside(endpoint,'ip','link','set',left,'name','eth0')
  for worker,name,host in [(endpoint,'eth0',1),(router,right,254)]:inside(worker,'ip','addr','add',network+'.'+str(host)+'/24','dev',name);inside(worker,'ip','link','set',name,'up')
 inside(router,'sysctl','-qw','net.ipv4.ip_forward=1');inside(client,'ip','route','add','198.19.0.0/24','via','198.18.0.254');inside(server,'ip','route','add','198.18.0.0/24','via','198.19.0.254')
 inside(client,'ip','addr','add','198.18.0.2/24','dev','eth0')
 inside(router,'nft','add','table','ip','opsforge_filter')
 inside(router,'nft','add','chain','ip','opsforge_filter','early','{ type filter hook forward priority 0; policy accept; }')
 inside(router,'nft','add','chain','ip','opsforge_filter','late','{ type filter hook forward priority 10; policy accept; }')
 inside(router,'nft','add','rule','ip','opsforge_filter','early','ip','saddr','198.18.0.1','tcp','dport','18443','counter','accept','comment','"early-accept"')
 inside(router,'nft','add','rule','ip','opsforge_filter','late','tcp','dport','18443','counter','drop','comment','"late-api-drop"')
 inside(router,'nft','add','table','ip','unrelated_keep')
 root=pathlib.Path.cwd();certificate=str(root/'filter-ca.pem');key=str(root/'filter-key.pem')
 run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',key);run('openssl','req','-new','-x509','-key',key,'-out',certificate,'-days','1','-subj','/CN=198.19.0.1','-addext','subjectAltName=IP:198.19.0.1')
 rpc(server,op='serve',certificate=certificate,key=key)
 def https(label,port=18443,source='198.18.0.1'):
  path='/approved/'+secrets.token_hex(12);r=rpc(client,op='https',label=label,port=port,path=path,certificate=certificate,source=source)
  if 'failed' not in r:assert r['status']==200 and r['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(path.encode()).hexdigest()
  return r
 assert 'failed' not in https('other-before',18444)
 assert 'failed' in https('blocked-before'),'later base chain must really drop traffic already accepted earlier'
 counters=json.loads(inside(router,'nft','-j','list','ruleset'))['nftables']
 for comment in ['early-accept','late-api-drop']:
  rule=next(x['rule'] for x in counters if x.get('rule',{}).get('comment')==comment);assert sum(x.get('counter',{}).get('packets',0) for x in rule['expr'])>0
 print('REAL_EARLY_ACCEPT_AND_LATER_DROP_COUNTERS_BOTH_HIT_TLS_BLOCKED_OTHER_API_HEALTHY',flush=True)
 before=snapshot(router);task.repair(router.pid)
 assert 'failed' not in https('approved-after'),'approved TLS must actually recover'
 assert 'failed' in https('unapproved-after',source='198.18.0.2'),'unapproved source must remain blocked'
 assert 'failed' not in https('other-before',18444)
 after=snapshot(router);added=[x['rule'] for x in after if x.get('rule',{}).get('comment')=='approved-exception'];assert len(added)==1
 assert [x for x in after if x.get('rule',{}).get('comment')!='approved-exception']==before,'every original chain/rule/table must remain'
 rule=added[0];assert rule['family']=='ip' and rule['table']=='opsforge_filter' and rule['chain']=='late'
 matches=[x['match'] for x in rule['expr'] if 'match' in x];required=[]
 for protocol,field,right in [('ip','saddr','198.18.0.1'),('ip','daddr','198.19.0.1'),('tcp','dport',18443)]:required.append({'op':'==','left':{'payload':{'protocol':protocol,'field':field}},'right':right})
 assert matches==required and rule['expr'][-1]=={'accept':None} and len(rule['expr'])==4,'only precise approved exception is allowed'
 task.repair(router.pid);assert snapshot(router)==after,'repair must be idempotent'
 seen=rpc(server,op='observed');assert {x['peer'][0] for x in seen if x['port']==18443}=={'198.18.0.1'}
 print('NATIVE_REAL_NFT_HIGHER_PRIORITY_BASE_CHAIN_EXCEPTION_APPROVED_TLS_RECOVERED_UNAPPROVED_SOURCE_STILL_DROPPED_ALL_OLD_RULES_AND_IDEMPOTENCY_PRESERVED',flush=True)
finally:
 for worker in reversed(workers):
  if worker.poll() is None:
   worker.terminate()
   try:worker.wait(timeout=3)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:worker.kill();worker.wait()
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
